meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 GitHub 上的代码改动变成一段讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚合并一批改动,想快速录一段讲解给团队或用户看。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a GitHub pull request into a video that explains the code change
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just merged changes and want a quick explainer video for your team or users.

howto.what: 把 GitHub 拉取请求（PR 链接、owner/repo#N 或“this PR”）转成讲解代码改动的视频：读 diff、提交和文件，产出 renders/video.mp4。不做产品宣传片或无 PR 的选题讲解。
howto.when: 当你给出 PR 链接、<owner>/<repo>#N，或在已检出仓库里说“this PR”时触发；意图不明确会先转到 /hyperframes。

say.text: 用 acme/sdk#1842 做一个重构走查视频
say.note: 按重构讲解类型组织叙事

say.text: 把当前仓库的这个 PR 讲成变更日志视频，配音用男声
say.note: 脚本通过后按指定声音生成旁白

howto.what_en: Turns a GitHub pull request (PR URL, owner/repo#N, or “this PR” in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video built from the diff, commits and files, rendering video.mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you give a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or say “this PR” in a checked-out repo. Unclear intent routes to /hyperframes first.
